en.headline: Observatory issues amber rainstorm warning as northern downpours continue
en.dek: The amber signal went up at 5:40pm, with the northern New Territories flooding announcement and the afternoon thunderstorm warning still in force.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 5:40pm on Friday, saying widespread areas had recorded, or were expected to record, rainfall of more than 30 millimetres an hour, and that the heavy rain could persist.

The Observatory said low-lying and poorly drained areas could flood, and advised people who might be affected to take precautions. It also warned that heavy rain could trigger flash floods, and told the public to stay away from watercourses. Listeners were asked to follow radio and television reports on traffic and other rain-related updates.

The Special Announcement on Flooding in the Northern New Territories, issued at 5pm, remained in force. The Observatory said the northern New Territories, especially around Sheung Shui, was being hit by heavy rain, with more than 70 millimetres recorded in that area in the previous hour.

A thunderstorm warning issued at 3:55pm was also still in force. The Observatory has advised people outdoors to seek shelter, to leave the water and avoid swimming or other outdoor water sports, and to stay off high ground and away from conductive objects, trees and masts.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色暴雨警告 新界北部大雨持續
zh.dek: 黃色暴雨警告於下午5時40分生效，新界北部水浸特別報告及下午的雷暴警告仍然有效。
body: 香港天文台星期五下午5時40分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，表示本港廣泛地區已錄得或預料會有每小時雨量超過30毫米的大雨，雨勢可能持續。
天文台指，低窪地帶及排水欠佳的地區可能出現水淹，可能受影響的市民應採取預防措施。大雨亦可能引致山洪暴發，市民應遠離河道，並留意電台及電視台有關交通及其他暴雨消息。
下午5時發出的新界北部水浸特別報告仍然有效。天文台表示，新界北部尤其是上水一帶正受大雨影響，該區過去一小時錄得超過70毫米雨量。
下午3時55分發出的雷暴警告亦仍然生效。天文台提醒，雷暴發生時應到安全地方躲避、離開水面，切勿游泳或進行戶外水上活動，亦不要站在高地或接近導電物體、樹木及桅杆。
